subject: Novum AI trial KPIs, SLO ownership, and next steps
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@novum.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@novum.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: trial success criteria + sample data

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap on our side and a first pass at what Novum would consider a successful trial (happy to refine).

High-level goals
- Validate that Redwood can serve our summarization/QA workload at production-like scale with predictable latency/cost.
- Establish measurable acceptance criteria we can take into procurement.

Suggested success criteria (please comment):
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end (request start to token stream start) < 120 ms for requests with ~512 tokens output (peak concurrency scenario).
- Throughput: sustained 50 requests/sec with 1:1 concurrency profile during peak windows; burst to 150 reqs/sec for short spikes.
- Cost: target average cost/token <= $0.0010 during the trial (open to Redwood's suggestion on realistic delta).
- Quality: automated accuracy on our labeled set >= 90% (we'll provide a labeled holdout), and no more than 3% critical failures (hallucinations / incorrect entity substitutions) on a 500-sample human review.

Data and access
- Attached a small anonymized sample (novum_data_sample.csv) to start; we'll share an S3 link with the full workload after we align on controls.

Timeline preference
- Kickoff next week, 3-week trial (integration + stress + readout). Procurement needs a clear acceptance statement by the readout.

Next steps we want from Redwood
1) Confirm these KPIs are reasonable and flag any tradeoffs (model variant, batching, quantization).
2) Outline owners (Redwood CS / perf / our infra) and a short timeline with milestones.
3) Provide a short blurb on what telemetry you'll need from our side (payload sizes, concurrency profile, auth).

Thanks — we want to get a kickoff on the calendar.

—Sarah
Sarah Collins
Head of ML Ops, Novum AI

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@novum.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: trial success criteria + sample data

Sarah — thanks for a thorough recap and the sample. This is a great starting point. Below is a concrete POC proposal with owners and a realistic set of gates so procurement has something to sign off on after the readout.

POC (3-week) high-level plan
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, before we exchange credentials): confirm dataset access, SLAs for telemetry, and firewall rules.
- Week 1 (integration): onboarding SDKs, auth, ingest sample traffic; baseline latency/throughput with default model. Deliverable: baseline dashboard + initial cost estimate.
- Week 2 (performance tuning): apply batching, KV cache for prefixes, and recommended quantization; run sustained load + burst tests. Deliverable: perf report (95p/median, tail behaviour) and cost per 1k tokens.
- Week 3 (evaluation + readout): run labeled holdout against acceptance criteria, collect human review sample, and deliver final readout for procurement.

Proposed acceptance statement (what procurement can sign)
- "Novum trial is successful if Redwood meets specified latency and throughput gates and achieves >= 90% automated accuracy on Novum's labeled holdout, with documented cost/token and no more than 3% critical failures in human review."

Owners (Redwood)
- Customer onboarding & trial ops: Monica Patel — will run kickoffs, coordinate data exchange, and track milestones.
- Performance & benchmark lead: Irene Choi — will own benchmarking, model variant selection, and tuning knobs (batching, quant).
- Commercial & billing point: Ben Carter — will produce cost estimates and contract/discount details for the trial.

Preliminary technical notes
- Model suggestion: start with a mid-sized open variant we tested in last year's benchmarks (we'll call out exact variant in the kickoff). If Novum needs lower latency, we can recommend a quantized variant + dedicated capacity.
- Initial cost estimate: aiming to keep avg cost/token near your target; exact numbers after we run the baseline with your sample and concurrency profile.

Attachments: POC-scope-and-metrics.xlsx (scope, explicit test cases), SLA-draft.pdf (outline for procurement).

Can we schedule a kickoff Thu 09/16 or Mon 09/20? I'll pencil in Mon 09/20 10:00 PT and share a calendar invite if that works.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

- For sustained 50 rps and bursts to 150 rps, what autoscaling config / reserved capacity would you suggest?
- Rough cost estimate (ballpark) in $/1k tokens for the sample workload with recommended config.

Ask for Monica
- I'll need you to lead the data exchange checklist and keep Novum notified on milestones. I'll copy Ben for billing alignment.

I attached the small sample they sent (novum_data_sample.csv) — use it to produce a quick baseline slide for the kickoff. Please reply by EOD so I can finalize the calendar and prep materials.

—Rafael
